scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Three-cent NAV reconciliation; monetary amounts versus analytical values.
IEEE-754 versus decimal arithmetic; ISO currency digits and banker rounding.
Same-currency enforcement; Rate, Bps and Percentage representations.
FX market pair, pips, inverse, triangulation and conversion policy.
Rounding and tolerance stamps, deterministic financial replay, independent staged snapshots.

build_workflows.coverage: Decimal Money, ValueError mismatch, FX cross/inverse/pip, config/result stamps and four-position foundation book.
Rate/Bps/Percentage conversions, currency decimals, accumulation and rounding examples.

exercises.original_requirement: Triangulate EURJPY from EURUSD and USDJPY and assert pip size.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Compute cross and inverse with native FxMatrix; assert 162 JPY/EUR and 0.01 JPY pip for the pinned quotes.

exercises.original_requirement: Demonstrate a float accumulation error and fix it with Money.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Accumulate the same decimal cashflow sequence with binary float and Money; assert exact Decimal total and show the float residual.

exercises.original_requirement: Extend the book with a GBP cash balance and re-render.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Extend a fresh PortfolioSpec with a dated GBP deposit, GBP discount data and GBPUSD quote; assert five holdings, currency conversion and unchanged original snapshot.

financial_and_api_decisions: Mismatch raises public ValueError, not FinstackError.
Money stores decimal amounts; current native pricing records f64. FinstackConfig cannot be passed where MetricPricingOverrides is expected.
Compare financial outputs; execution timestamps differ. Serial/parallel seeded MC comparison is demonstrated in 2.6.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Business days, holidays and Following/Modified Following/Preceding.
ACT/360, ACT/365F, 30/360 variants, ACT/ACT ISDA and ICMA reference periods.
Tenors, end-of-month rolls, short/long front/back stubs.
Futures IMM, CDS quarterly dates, option expiries, settlement conventions.

build_workflows.coverage: Four hand-checked accrual fractions, Modified Following month crossing, short-front/long-back schedules, IMM/CDS/third Friday.
30/360 variants, ISDA leap-year split, ICMA reference-period context, EOM and calendar comparison.

exercises.original_requirement: Find the ACT/360 versus 30/360 accrual difference on the USD bond coupon.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Use shared USD bond notional/rate and the same period; compute currency coupon difference and assert the hand-computed amount.

exercises.original_requirement: Build a semiannual schedule with a long back stub and explain the last period.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Use Schedule.builder; assert final dates and longer final accrual, explain the effect on coupon amount.

exercises.original_requirement: List 2026 CDS roll dates.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Generate the quarterly twentieth dates and assert the full sequence, contrasting futures third Wednesdays.

financial_and_api_decisions: Schedule.builder is the supported fluent entry point.
ICMA needs a reference coupon period; it is not interchangeable with ACT/ACT ISDA.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Simple, annual, semiannual and continuous compounding; basis conversions.
DF, zero, interval forward and instantaneous forward relations.

SOFR/ESTR/SONIA/TONA overnight compounding and fixing calendars.
Separate discounting and projection roles.

build_workflows.coverage: Four 5% convention PVs on 100m, curve identities and manual native bond cashflow PV reconciliation.
Historical shared SOFR fixings, native compounded-in-arrears coupon and explicit weekend-weight product.
Convert numerical rate representations at equal DF and illustrate interval versus instantaneous forward.

exercises.original_requirement: Prove the forward-rate no-arbitrage identity numerically.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Reconstruct DF(t2) from DF(t1) and the interval forward; assert numerical closure.

exercises.original_requirement: Reprice a cashflow when the curve steepens.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Create a fresh curve with an explicitly increasing tenor shock; reprice the same cashflow and explain timing exposure, asserting baseline preservation.

financial_and_api_decisions: Foundation market contains actual FIXING:USD-SOFR observations.
Overnight weekend observations carry their calendar-day weights.
Manual arithmetic stays visible; no shared helper performs hidden finance.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Deposits, futures/FRA and swaps as calibration instruments.
Sequential bootstrap root finding and one-knot swap annuity algebra.
Linear DF, linear-zero conceptual comparison, log-linear DF and monotone-convex interpolation.
Between-pillar forwards and local/global curve risk effects.
OIS discounting and separate projection curves after the multi-curve transition.

build_workflows.coverage: Canonical deposit/IRS strip, repricing residual, linear/log_linear forward comparison and dropped-quote effect.
Derive a terminal swap discount factor from known earlier coupons and compare with a native calibrated knot.
Reuse the canonical FRA/forward calibration envelope for separate projection; explain futures quote and convexity adjustment assumptions.
Plot the interpolation alternatives and compare the same bond against an explicitly labelled simple hand curve.

exercises.original_requirement: Drop one instrument from the strip and identify which curve segment moved.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Remove the 5y quote, recalibrate, display node and forward deltas and assert a changed segment without assuming all other values stay fixed.

exercises.original_requirement: Explain why a 10y knot bump moves 9y forwards under linear-zero interpolation.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Show the linearly interpolated zero equation and resulting forward derivative on the shared segment; assert a nonzero 9y response and explain endpoint influence.

financial_and_api_decisions: Do not call native linear interpolation linear-zero without inspecting the stored variable.

Futures treatment remains mandatory: 100-minus-price, underlying accrual and explicit futures/FRA convexity assumption. The shared main strip uses deposit/IRS quotes and the supported separate forward example uses FRAs.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Implied volatility, strike/expiry surfaces, smile and skew.
Total-variance interpolation and calendar arbitrage.
FX forward/spot/premium-adjusted delta conventions.

Risk-neutral versus physical default beliefs; base correlation preview.
MarketContext snapshot with price, inflation, volatility index and cube roles.

build_workflows.coverage: Total variance interpolation, calendar violation and forward-delta FX wing-to-strike query.
Fixed-hazard versus fixed-quote recovery experiments with lossless calibration replay.
Annual survival/PD table and a fresh context holding independent curve/surface objects.

exercises.original_requirement: Show a calendar-arbitrage violation when total variance decreases.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Build the decreasing total-variance case at a fixed forward/moneyness assumption; assert diagnostic failure and explain why declining volatility alone is insufficient.

exercises.original_requirement: Compute 5y cumulative PD at two recoveries and explain the hazard primitive.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Assert unchanged survival at fixed hazard, then recalibrate unchanged quotes at 40% and 25% recovery and assert lower implied PD at lower recovery; explain severity versus intensity.

financial_and_api_decisions: Current delta-to-strike path is forward delta, not a claim of premium-adjusted support.
A standalone 1.5 hazard experiment does not add CDS positions to earlier book snapshots.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.

build_workflows.coverage: Typed Bond, result/registry access, price-yield round trip, fixed-quote and fixed-curve settlement experiments.
Native amortizing cashflow schedule converted to a priceable bond, shorter duration.
Typed builder, explicit ex-coupon/convention case and callable call_put/ytw teaser.
Supported StepUpCouponSpec schedule and explicit street versus actual-date yield demonstration.

exercises.original_requirement: Settlement-date shift moves accrued but not clean.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Correct the unconditional premise: assert clean invariance at fixed quoted clean price and show non-invariance at fixed discount curve; accrued rises in both examples.

exercises.original_requirement: Step-up coupon via StepUpCouponSpec and its YTM effect.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Build the native step-up schedule, materialize a bond, hold the comparison price assumption explicitly and show/assert the yield effect.

exercises.original_requirement: Explain street versus true yield on one number.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Use the same price and payment schedule, contrasting periodic street discount times with actual adjusted payment dates; assert each convention reprices its own cashflow equation and explain the difference.

financial_and_api_decisions: Correct metrics are accrued and duration_mod.
CashFlowSchedule.builder and bond_from_cashflows_json are the supported cashflow-to-bond route.
Callable OAS depth remains C1; the introductory call/ytw example is still required here.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Macaulay/modified duration, signed DV01 and yield convexity.
Bucketed/key-rate curve sensitivities and fully qualified key grammar.
G, I, Z, ASW, discount margin and OAS comparison, with benchmark and units.
Embedded-option value and z-spread CS01 convention.
Taylor P&L approximation, curve versus yield shocks and residual interpretation.

build_workflows.coverage: Signed DV01 bump check, qualified buckets, z-spread CS01, ASW stub and 25bp Taylor/reprice comparison.
Explicit government-benchmark G-spread, native I/Z/ASW and interpretation table; FRN discount margin and callable OAS preview.
Macaulay/modified relationship and native convexity scaling in the yield Taylor equation.

exercises.original_requirement: Which bucket owns risk of a 7y bond on a {2,5,10,30} curve?
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Use a shared four-node curve and 7y bond, inspect actual bucket split and assert its reconciliation; explain interpolation-driven neighboring exposure rather than assigning all risk to one bucket.

exercises.original_requirement: Compute cs01::<id> via z-spread bump and explain the convention.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Compare native cs01::USD-CORP with explicit symmetric z-spread repricing under the same base quote and sign units.

exercises.original_requirement: Duration of amortizer versus bullet: why shorter?
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Price both native instruments with matched input assumptions, assert shorter duration and connect to earlier principal repayments.

financial_and_api_decisions: Native DV01 is signed +1bp PV change and is negative for the long bond.
Native bond convexity is (Psecond/P)/100; multiply by 100 in a decimal-yield Taylor equation.
ASW example uses a fresh short_front stub copy for its settlement-to-maturity leg.
No unsupported g_spread registry alias: the government benchmark subtraction is displayed directly.
Bond no-hazard CS01 is a settlement-anchored forward +1bp periodically compounded z-spread difference, reproduced with quoted_z_spread.
I-spread, Z-spread, ASW and discount margin are returned as decimal rates; bp display requires multiplication by 10000.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Swap fixed/float cashflow signs, discount/project roles and annuity-weighted par.
Off-par value, bond/swap DV01 hedge and remaining basis/key-rate risk.
Cap/floor as caplet/floorlet strips and Black-76 vega.
Payer/receiver swaptions and physical/cash settlement.
Normal absolute-rate volatility versus lognormal decimal volatility.
Cross-currency basis and CMS/in-arrears convexity previews.

build_workflows.coverage: Native payer swap, zero NPV at par, signed USD-bond hedge and qualified forward PV01.
Native caplet strip, matched cap-floor=swap, Black-76 vega and payer swaption.
Typed leg builder and visible fixed annuity/projected float PV algebra; settlement and normal-vol alternative discussion.

Build the payer swaption explicitly. The call option type is the payer right. Physical settlement is selected explicitly; the cash-settlement method remains a required contract field but does not convert this into a cash-settled option. The fixed and floating underlying legs begin after expiry. Absolute short-rate volatility is not used here: the Black surface contains lognormal rate volatility.

exercises.original_requirement: Solve notional to DV01-neutralize the book bonds with the swap.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Convert EUR bond currency risk to USD before combining with USD bond DV01; solve payer units and assert parallel net risk zero, then explain remaining curve basis.

exercises.original_requirement: Cap-floor parity equals swap check.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Reproduce the proven actual quarterly projection grid, price native cap/floor/matched payer swap and assert parity to a cent.

exercises.original_requirement: Forward par rate from curve versus par_rate metric.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Sum native projected floating coupon PVs and fixed-leg annuity on identical schedules; assert their ratio equals the native par_rate metric.

financial_and_api_decisions: Use actual ACT/360 quarterly boundaries in ForwardCurve projection_grid; numeric 0.25-year stepping differs from actual month lengths.
Cap implied period-forward and IRS reset-date fixing agree under the matched projection grid.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Risk-neutral/no-arbitrage intuition and BSM/Black-76 formulas.
Delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho units and spot-grid behavior.
Implied volatility inversion, smile/skew and staged surface lookup.
SABR asymptotics/calibration, fixed beta and rho/nu interpretation.
SVI parameterization and arbitrage context.
COS transform agreement; native equity options and Garman-Kohlhagen FX options.

build_workflows.coverage: Native scaled option versus BSM/COS/IV, financed five-day short-option delta hedge.
Synthetic known-parameter SABR smile fit with fixed beta and quote residual check.
Delta/gamma/vega/theta/rho plots and units, surface strike query and native typed builder.
Fit/quote plot, rho and nu perturbation, SVI parameterization and limits.

Construct the native book option. The builder exposes the 100-unit multiplier, spot, dividend, discount and volatility identifiers. It matches the canonical book option and queries the three surface smile points at the actual expiry. Native Greeks include position scaling.

Plot quotes against the fitted smile. The quote points and fitted curve share decimal-volatility units. The residuals printed in volatility basis points make a visually close fit quantitatively reviewable.

exercises.original_requirement: Delta hedge over one fixture week: gamma explains residual.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Use the proven full ledger with borrowing interest, dividends and financed rebalance; assert self-financing and compare P&L with gamma plus theta and carry, not gamma alone.

exercises.original_requirement: FxOptionBuilder under Garman-Kohlhagen with delta-quoted vol.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Build the native FX option using shared domestic/foreign curves, FX spot and EURUSD delta surface; compare with supported Garman-Kohlhagen economics and assert agreement with explicit delta convention.

exercises.original_requirement: Why is SABR beta fixed by desk convention rather than fit?
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Keep beta fixed in each native fit, compare quote reproduction and parameter shifts, assert the chosen beta values and explain identification/hedging stability.

financial_and_api_decisions: Equity option default registry key is black76 with BSM spot/carry economics.
Standalone formulas are per underlying unit; native book option scales by 100.
SABR fit tolerance is 1e-6 decimal volatility, or 0.01 volatility basis points.

The native FX option uses a visible delta-smile lookup at the actual forward and a pinned implied-volatility override for the GK reconciliation; two dated DFs determine rates on the option expiry basis.

scope: Full original per-lesson plan and companion syllabus; no optional cuts.
concepts: Default time, hazard, survival and recovery.
CDS premium/protection legs, accrual on default and ISDA step-in/settlement/CDS date conventions.
Hazard bootstrap, quote residuals and retained replay.
Standardized coupons and upfront conversion.
Hazard quote CS01 versus bond z-spread CS01.
Protection-leg interval decomposition; CDX/iTraxx/index basis and reduced-form/structural previews.

build_workflows.coverage: Typed CDS, par spread in bp, zero par NPV, replay CS01, upfront PV fraction and interval protection PV decomposition.
Typed ISDA-NA builder, hazard calibration closure, step-in/settlement timeline and standardized coupon/upfront cash conversion.
Flat hazard native par spread versus spread approximately (1-recovery) times hazard.

Build the regional contract and bootstrap its quotes. The native premium/protection builders expose recovery, calendar and start/end dates. The fresh calibration input displays the complete CDS quote strip and returns a CalibrationResult. A maximum residual-to-tolerance ratio below one passes its numerical gate; the forward-starting contract has different dates from the spot calibration pillars, so its par spread need not equal the five-year input quote.

exercises.original_requirement: Recovery 40 to 25 at fixed spread: what moved and why?
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Recalibrate unchanged CDS quotes with changed recovery, assert lower implied hazard/PD at lower recovery, retain serialization/replay and explain loss severity.

exercises.original_requirement: Check spread approximately (1-R) times lambda accuracy.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Use native CDS under an explicit flat hazard and discount environment, compare basis-point par spread to the approximation and quantify error sources.

exercises.original_requirement: Add CDS hedge to the book and compute net CS01.
exercises.solution_and_assertions: Value the staged book with strict applicable risk, use native aggregate_metrics and display qualified hazard/instrument keys; compare before/after without treating unlike CS01 conventions as an automatic hedge.

financial_and_api_decisions: Actual CDS registry model is hazard_rate.
par_spread returns basis points; no unsupported upfront metric is requested.
PV upfront fraction and settlement cash differ by the settlement DF.
Protection interval contributions are differences of cumulative native leg PVs; no fabricated diagnostic or hidden pricing wrapper.
The CDS is forward-starting on 2025-03-20 from valuation 2025-01-15. The separate illustrative T+3 upfront cash date is not the protection default-settlement delay.
